```{r}
# ============================================================
# Random Forest prediction analysis
# TERM vs sPTB
# Candidate fungi, viruses, BMI, cytokines and metabolites
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(caret)
  library(randomForest)
  library(pROC)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
})

set.seed(123)

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"
data_dir     <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

rf_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Random_forest")
rf_figures_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "Random_forest")

dir.create(rf_results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(rf_figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

# ============================================================
# Read metadata
# ============================================================

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)

# ============================================================
# Colour maps
# ============================================================

get_fungal_color_map <- function() {
  c(
    "Epichloe"            = "#0072B2",
    "Aspergillus"         = "#E69F00",
    "Saccharomyces"       = "#56B4E9",
    "Candida"             = "#009E73",
    "Venturia"            = "#CC79A7",
    "Lodderomyces"        = "#F0E442",
    "Coccidioides"        = "#D55E00",
    "Lachancea"           = "#332288",
    "Botrytis"            = "#88CCEE",
    "Sphaerulina"         = "#117733",
    "Schizosaccharomyces" = "#AA4499",
    "Kwoniella"           = "#DDCC77",
    "Fusarium"            = "#44AA99",
    "Trichoderma"         = "#CC6677",
    "Nakaseomyces"        = "#882255",
    "Cryptococcus"        = "#117733",
    "Puccinia"            = "#AA4499"
  )
}

get_viral_color_map <- function() {
  c(
    "Oryzopoxvirus"        = "#0072B2",
    "Alphapapillomavirus" = "#E69F00",
    "Cukevirus"           = "#56B4E9",
    "Epseptimavirus"      = "#009E73",
    "Shenzhenivirus"      = "#CC79A7",
    "Cytomegalovirus"     = "#F0E442",
    "Aurunvirus"          = "#D55E00",
    "Moonvirus"           = "#332288",
    "Gelderlandvirus"     = "#88CCEE",
    "Rockvillevirus"      = "#117733",
    "Spinunavirus"        = "#AA4499",
    "Orthoflavivirus"     = "#DDCC77",
    "Gettysburgvirus"     = "#44AA99",
    "Schiekvirus"         = "#CC6677",
    "Fohxhuevirus"        = "#882255"
  )
}

model_cols <- c(
  "BMI only" = "#999999",
  "Fungi + viruses" = "#0072B2",
  "Fungi + viruses + BMI" = "#E69F00",
  "Fungi + viruses + BMI + host metabolites" = "#009E73"
)

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

read_matrix <- function(file_path) {
  mat <- read.delim(
    file_path,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
  mat[] <- lapply(mat, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  return(mat)
}

align_to_metadata <- function(mat, meta) {
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))

  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)

  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }

  meta_matched <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]

  if (!all(meta_matched$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }

  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  rownames(meta_matched) <- meta_matched$reads_ID

  return(list(mat = mat, meta = meta_matched))
}

select_existing_features <- function(mat, features, layer_name) {
  present <- intersect(features, colnames(mat))
  missing <- setdiff(features, colnames(mat))

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message("Missing in ", layer_name, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (length(present) == 0) {
    stop("No requested features found in ", layer_name)
  }

  mat[, present, drop = FALSE]
}

clr_transform <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)

  min_positive <- min(mat[mat > 0], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(min_positive)) {
    stop("No positive values available for CLR transformation.")
  }

  pseudocount <- min_positive / 2
  mat_pc <- mat + pseudocount

  clr <- t(apply(mat_pc, 1, function(x) {
    log(x) - mean(log(x))
  }))

  clr <- as.data.frame(clr)
  rownames(clr) <- rownames(mat)

  return(clr)
}

zscore_matrix <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)

  mat <- mat[, apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }), drop = FALSE]

  scaled <- scale(mat)
  scaled[is.na(scaled)] <- 0

  scaled <- as.data.frame(scaled)
  rownames(scaled) <- rownames(mat)

  return(scaled)
}

format_feature_names <- function(x) {
  recode(
    x,
    "bmi" = "BMI",
    "IL6" = "IL-6",
    "IL37_pg_mL" = "IL-37",
    "Lactate" = "Lactate",
    "Succinate" = "Succinate",
    "Putrescine" = "Putrescine"
  )
}

get_feature_group <- function(feature) {
  case_when(
    feature %in% c(
      "Aspergillus", "Fusarium", "Cryptococcus",
      "Puccinia", "Saccharomyces", "Trichoderma"
    ) ~ "Fungal",
    feature %in% c("Shenzhenivirus", "Fohxhuevirus") ~ "Viral",
    feature %in% c("IL6", "IL37_pg_mL") ~ "Cytokine",
    feature %in% c("Lactate", "Succinate", "Putrescine") ~ "Metabolite",
    feature == "bmi" ~ "Clinical",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

run_rf_model <- function(model_df, outcome_col, model_name, model_label) {

  model_df <- model_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome_col]]))

  model_df[[outcome_col]] <- factor(
    model_df[[outcome_col]],
    levels = c("sPTB", "TERM")
  )

  predictors <- model_df %>%
    select(-reads_ID, -sample_label, -all_of(outcome_col))

  predictors <- predictors[, apply(predictors, 2, function(x) {
    sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }), drop = FALSE]

  final_df <- bind_cols(
    outcome = model_df[[outcome_col]],
    predictors
  )

  colnames(final_df)[1] <- outcome_col

  # Repeated cross-validation is used for performance estimation.
  # This avoids an unstable single train/test split in a small cohort.
  ctrl_repeated <- trainControl(
    method = "repeatedcv",
    number = 5,
    repeats = 20,
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final"
  )

  rf_fit <- train(
    as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ .")),
    data = final_df,
    method = "rf",
    metric = "ROC",
    trControl = ctrl_repeated,
    tuneLength = 5,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  best_mtry <- rf_fit$bestTune$mtry

  pred_best <- rf_fit$pred %>%
    filter(mtry == best_mtry)

  roc_obj <- roc(
    response = pred_best$obs,
    predictor = pred_best$sPTB,
    levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"),
    direction = "<"
  )

  confusion_repeated <- confusionMatrix(
    data = pred_best$pred,
    reference = pred_best$obs,
    positive = "sPTB"
  )

  # A single 5-fold cross-validation pass is used to produce one
  # out-of-fold prediction per sample for the confusion matrix.
  ctrl_single <- trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 5,
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final"
  )

  rf_fit_single <- train(
    as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ .")),
    data = final_df,
    method = "rf",
    metric = "ROC",
    trControl = ctrl_single,
    tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = best_mtry),
    importance = TRUE
  )

  pred_single <- rf_fit_single$pred %>%
    filter(mtry == best_mtry)

  confusion_single <- confusionMatrix(
    data = pred_single$pred,
    reference = pred_single$obs,
    positive = "sPTB"
  )

  performance <- data.frame(
    model = model_name,
    model_label = model_label,
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    Accuracy = as.numeric(confusion_repeated$overall["Accuracy"]),
    Sensitivity = as.numeric(confusion_repeated$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Specificity = as.numeric(confusion_repeated$byClass["Specificity"]),
    Balanced_Accuracy = as.numeric(confusion_repeated$byClass["Balanced Accuracy"]),
    best_mtry = best_mtry,
    n_samples = nrow(final_df),
    n_predictors = ncol(predictors)
  )

  importance <- varImp(rf_fit)$importance %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature")

  if (!"Overall" %in% colnames(importance)) {
    importance_cols <- setdiff(colnames(importance), "feature")
    importance$Overall <- importance[[importance_cols[1]]]
  }

  importance <- importance %>%
    mutate(
      feature_group = get_feature_group(feature),
      feature_label = format_feature_names(feature)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Overall))

  write.csv(
    performance,
    file.path(rf_results_dir, paste0(model_name, "_performance.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    importance,
    file.path(rf_results_dir, paste0(model_name, "_feature_importance.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    as.data.frame(confusion_single$table),
    file.path(rf_results_dir, paste0(model_name, "_confusion_matrix_5fold.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(
    rf_fit,
    file.path(rf_results_dir, paste0(model_name, "_repeated_cv_model.rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    rf_fit_single,
    file.path(rf_results_dir, paste0(model_name, "_single_5fold_model.rds"))
  )

  return(list(
    model = rf_fit,
    model_single = rf_fit_single,
    performance = performance,
    importance = importance,
    confusion_repeated = confusion_repeated,
    confusion_single = confusion_single,
    roc = roc_obj,
    predictions_repeated = pred_best,
    predictions_single = pred_single
  ))
}

# ============================================================
# Read and align fungal and viral data
# ============================================================

fungi <- read_matrix(fungal_file)
fungi_aligned <- align_to_metadata(fungi, meta)

fungi <- fungi_aligned$mat
meta_aligned <- fungi_aligned$meta

viruses <- read_matrix(viral_file)
viruses_aligned <- align_to_metadata(viruses, meta)

viruses <- viruses_aligned$mat

# ============================================================
# Define selected features
# ============================================================

fungal_candidates <- c(
  "Aspergillus",
  "Fusarium",
  "Cryptococcus",
  "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces",
  "Trichoderma"
)

viral_candidates <- c(
  "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus"
)

selected_host_features <- c(
  "IL6",
  "IL37_pg_mL",
  "Lactate",
  "Succinate",
  "Putrescine"
)

# ============================================================
# Check that metadata-derived predictors exist
# ============================================================

required_metadata_predictors <- c(
  "bmi",
  selected_host_features
)

missing_metadata_predictors <- setdiff(
  required_metadata_predictors,
  colnames(meta_aligned)
)

if (length(missing_metadata_predictors) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These required metadata predictors are missing from metadata_clean.tsv: ",
    paste(missing_metadata_predictors, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Prepare fungal and viral model layers
# ============================================================

fungal_layer <- fungi %>%
  select_existing_features(fungal_candidates, "RefSeq fungi") %>%
  clr_transform() %>%
  zscore_matrix()

viral_layer <- viruses %>%
  select_existing_features(viral_candidates, "RefSeq viruses") %>%
  clr_transform() %>%
  zscore_matrix()

# ============================================================
# Prepare BMI and host feature layers from metadata
# ============================================================

bmi_layer <- meta_aligned[, "bmi", drop = FALSE]
bmi_layer$bmi <- as.numeric(as.character(bmi_layer$bmi))
rownames(bmi_layer) <- meta_aligned$reads_ID
bmi_layer <- zscore_matrix(bmi_layer)

host_layer <- meta_aligned[, selected_host_features, drop = FALSE]
host_layer[] <- lapply(
  host_layer,
  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
)
rownames(host_layer) <- meta_aligned$reads_ID
host_layer <- zscore_matrix(host_layer)

# ============================================================
# Match samples across all layers
# ============================================================

common_samples <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    rownames(fungal_layer),
    rownames(viral_layer),
    rownames(bmi_layer),
    rownames(host_layer)
  )
)

metadata_model <- meta_aligned[
  common_samples,
  c("reads_ID", "sample_label", "outcome"),
  drop = FALSE
]

# ============================================================
# Remove samples with missing outcome or model predictors
# ============================================================

complete_sample_check <- bind_cols(
  metadata_model,
  fungal_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  viral_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  bmi_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  host_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
)

complete_samples <- complete_sample_check$reads_ID[
  complete.cases(complete_sample_check)
]

metadata_model <- metadata_model[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# Build four Random Forest input datasets
# ============================================================

rf_input_bmi <- bind_cols(
  metadata_model,
  bmi_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]
)

rf_input_microbiome <- bind_cols(
  metadata_model,
  fungal_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  viral_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]
)

rf_input_microbiome_bmi <- bind_cols(
  metadata_model,
  fungal_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  viral_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  bmi_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]
)

rf_input_integrated <- bind_cols(
  metadata_model,
  fungal_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  viral_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  bmi_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  host_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]
)

# ============================================================
# Run Random Forest models
# ============================================================

rf_bmi <- run_rf_model(
  model_df = rf_input_bmi,
  outcome_col = "outcome",
  model_name = "RF_A_BMI_only",
  model_label = "BMI only"
)

rf_microbiome <- run_rf_model(
  model_df = rf_input_microbiome,
  outcome_col = "outcome",
  model_name = "RF_B_fungi_viruses_only",
  model_label = "Fungi + viruses"
)

rf_microbiome_bmi <- run_rf_model(
  model_df = rf_input_microbiome_bmi,
  outcome_col = "outcome",
  model_name = "RF_C_fungi_viruses_BMI",
  model_label = "Fungi + viruses + BMI"
)

rf_integrated <- run_rf_model(
  model_df = rf_input_integrated,
  outcome_col = "outcome",
  model_name = "RF_D_fungi_viruses_BMI_host_metabolites",
  model_label = "Fungi + viruses + BMI + host metabolites"
)

# ============================================================
# Compare performance across models
# ============================================================

performance_all <- bind_rows(
  rf_bmi$performance,
  rf_microbiome$performance,
  rf_microbiome_bmi$performance,
  rf_integrated$performance
)

performance_all$model_label <- factor(
  performance_all$model_label,
  levels = c(
    "BMI only",
    "Fungi + viruses",
    "Fungi + viruses + BMI",
    "Fungi + viruses + BMI + host metabolites"
  )
)

write.csv(
  performance_all,
  file.path(rf_results_dir, "RF_model_performance_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(performance_all)

# ============================================================
# AUC comparison plot
# ============================================================

p_auc <- ggplot(performance_all, aes(x = model_label, y = AUC, fill = model_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(AUC, 3)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols) +
  ylim(0, max(performance_all$AUC, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.12) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest model performance",
    y = "Repeated cross-validated AUC"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(rf_figures_dir, "RF_AUC_comparison.png"),
  p_auc,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_auc)

# ============================================================
# ROC curves for all models
# ============================================================

roc_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    false_positive_rate = 1 - rf_bmi$roc$specificities,
    sensitivity = rf_bmi$roc$sensitivities,
    model_label = paste0("BMI only (AUC = ", round(rf_bmi$performance$AUC, 3), ")"),
    model_colour = "BMI only"
  ),
  data.frame(
    false_positive_rate = 1 - rf_microbiome$roc$specificities,
    sensitivity = rf_microbiome$roc$sensitivities,
    model_label = paste0("Fungi + viruses (AUC = ", round(rf_microbiome$performance$AUC, 3), ")"),
    model_colour = "Fungi + viruses"
  ),
  data.frame(
    false_positive_rate = 1 - rf_microbiome_bmi$roc$specificities,
    sensitivity = rf_microbiome_bmi$roc$sensitivities,
    model_label = paste0("Fungi + viruses + BMI (AUC = ", round(rf_microbiome_bmi$performance$AUC, 3), ")"),
    model_colour = "Fungi + viruses + BMI"
  ),
  data.frame(
    false_positive_rate = 1 - rf_integrated$roc$specificities,
    sensitivity = rf_integrated$roc$sensitivities,
    model_label = paste0("Fungi + viruses + BMI + host metabolites (AUC = ", round(rf_integrated$performance$AUC, 3), ")"),
    model_colour = "Fungi + viruses + BMI + host metabolites"
  )
)

roc_label_cols <- setNames(
  model_cols[unique(roc_df$model_colour)],
  unique(roc_df$model_label)
)

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(x = false_positive_rate, y = sensitivity, colour = model_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "#999999"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = roc_label_cols) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest ROC curves",
    x = "False positive rate (1 - specificity)",
    y = "Sensitivity"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(rf_figures_dir, "RF_ROC_curves_with_AUC.png"),
  p_roc,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_roc)

# ============================================================
# Feature importance plot for integrated model
# ============================================================

feature_colour_map <- c(
  get_fungal_color_map(),
  get_viral_color_map(),
  "BMI" = "#999999",
  "IL-6" = "#009E73",
  "IL-37" = "#CC79A7",
  "Lactate" = "#56B4E9",
  "Succinate" = "#E69F00",
  "Putrescine" = "#D55E00"
)

importance_integrated <- rf_integrated$importance %>%
  slice_head(n = 12) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = factor(
      feature_label,
      levels = rev(feature_label)
    )
  )

feature_colour_map_integrated <- feature_colour_map[
  levels(importance_integrated$feature_label)
]

p_imp_integrated <- ggplot(
  importance_integrated,
  aes(x = feature_label, y = Overall, fill = feature_label)
) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feature_colour_map_integrated, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top predictors in integrated Random Forest model",
    y = "Variable importance"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(rf_figures_dir, "RF_integrated_feature_importance.png"),
  p_imp_integrated,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_imp_integrated)

# ============================================================
# Confusion matrix heatmaps
# ============================================================

plot_confusion_heatmap <- function(confusion_obj, model_label, file_label) {

  cm <- as.data.frame(confusion_obj$table)
  colnames(cm) <- c("Prediction", "Reference", "N")

  cm$Prediction <- factor(cm$Prediction, levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"))
  cm$Reference <- factor(cm$Reference, levels = c("TERM", "sPTB"))

  p <- ggplot(cm, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = N)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = N), size = 5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#0072B2") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Confusion matrix: ", model_label),
      x = "Observed outcome",
      y = "Predicted outcome",
      fill = "Samples"
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(rf_figures_dir, paste0(file_label, "_confusion_matrix_5fold.png")),
    p,
    width = 5,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 300
  )

  return(p)
}

p_cm_bmi <- plot_confusion_heatmap(
  rf_bmi$confusion_single,
  "BMI only",
  "RF_A_BMI_only"
)

p_cm_microbiome <- plot_confusion_heatmap(
  rf_microbiome$confusion_single,
  "Fungi + viruses",
  "RF_B_fungi_viruses_only"
)

p_cm_microbiome_bmi <- plot_confusion_heatmap(
  rf_microbiome_bmi$confusion_single,
  "Fungi + viruses + BMI",
  "RF_C_fungi_viruses_BMI"
)

p_cm_integrated <- plot_confusion_heatmap(
  rf_integrated$confusion_single,
  "Fungi + viruses + BMI + host metabolites",
  "RF_D_fungi_viruses_BMI_host_metabolites"
)

print(p_cm_integrated)

# ============================================================
# Combined feature importance table
# ============================================================

importance_summary <- bind_rows(
  rf_microbiome$importance %>%
    mutate(model = "RF_B_fungi_viruses_only"),

  rf_microbiome_bmi$importance %>%
    mutate(model = "RF_C_fungi_viruses_BMI"),

  rf_integrated$importance %>%
    mutate(model = "RF_D_fungi_viruses_BMI_host_metabolites")
)

write.csv(
  importance_summary,
  file.path(rf_results_dir, "RF_all_feature_importance_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Save reproducibility information
# ============================================================

sink(file.path(rf_results_dir, "session_info.txt"))
sessionInfo()
sink()
```
